artBrief: **Expressive anime pixel art.** A delighted notebook character raises a pencil like a dramatic prop, with flying bookmarks and a spotlight-shaped burst. No rendered handwriting.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Expressive anime pixel art. A delighted notebook character raises a pencil like a dramatic prop, with flying bookmarks and a spotlight-shaped burst. No rendered handwriting. One cheerful coral notebook character, with expressive eyes and small arms, lifts a large pencil dramatically. Two flowing bookmarks and golden theatrical rays, no written page content.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
